content: {"reasoning": "Prior authorization is REQUIRED and MISSING for CPT 93229, this payer offers no retroactive authorization window and no peer-to-peer review. Any submission would draw an unappealable no-auth denial (medical-necessity appeal doesn't cure a procedural auth failure), and the balance cannot be shifted to the patient since it is provider liability. With no available action able to obtain payment from the payer, the only proper progression is to close the balance and avoid wasting touches on a guaranteed denial.", "action": "write_off"}
